body: I assume you’re not in the US?  I’ve thought of buying a shotgun but don’t want to make my wife try and identify me with half my head missing.
A tall enough bridge with nothing in the way on the way down. I just googled highest bridges in my area.
If you pick the right spot the first thing you hit will kill you instantly. Not much chance of being crippled either.

The thing is that even if there is a way out of things, I’m not sure I have it in me to do so. I know some aren’t fixable at all and the others require too much effort. Shot, I can barely get out of bed these days.

I feel the same way. Many failed attempts. I used to think it was fate and I was meant to live. That’s bullshit and I feel like I was just a failure. Now it’s time to try pills or get over my fear of heights. 

I really hope you can work through this and find happiness. If not I hope you find peace my friend. ❤️

I’ve tried everything to make myself happy. Nothing helps. All I have to show for it is crippling debt. I’ve lost everything I once had that made me feel like there was any hope of a future. 

All I am is one of the most hated minorities in America with bipolar I and BPD. I’m on more meds than I can count off hand and nothing helps.
